# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 23 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Sinaiticus (ch 1-31) / P.Mich. 130 (ch 32+), Shepherd of Hermas 23 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_023_page_001.jpg

---

## Vision 4, Chapter 2

**1** After I had passed the beast, and had gone forward about thirty feet, there met me a certain maiden, adorned as if she were coming from a bridal chamber, clothed entirely in white, with white sandals, with a veil up to her forehead, and with a turban — but her hair was white. **2** From my former visions I recognized that she was the Church, and I was more joyful. She greeted me and said: "Greetings, man of God!" And I greeted her in return, saying: "Greetings, lady!" **3** She replied and said to me: "Did nothing meet you on the road?" I said, "Lady, such a huge beast, able to destroy peoples — but through the power of God and his mercy I escaped it." **4** "You escaped well," she said, "because you cast your care upon God and opened your heart to the Lord, believing that you can be saved through nothing except through the great and glorious name. Therefore the Lord sent his angel, the one who has authority over the beasts, whose name is Segri, and he shut the beast's mouth, that it might not harm you. You have escaped a great tribulation on account of your faith, and because you did not waver when you saw such a huge beast. **5** Go therefore and tell the Lord's elect of his great deeds, and tell them that this beast is a foreshadowing of the great tribulation that is coming. If therefore you prepare yourselves and repent with your whole hearts toward the Lord, you will be able to escape it — if your heart is pure and blameless, and if you serve the Lord blamelessly for the rest of the days of your life. Cast your cares upon the Lord and he will deal with them. **6** Believe in the Lord, you who are double-minded, that he is able to do all things, and turns his anger from you, and sends plagues upon those who are double-minded. Woe to those who hear these words and disobey! Better for them not to have been born."

---

*EMET note: The maiden in white = the Church in her youthful/renewed form. The angel "Segri" (some manuscripts: Thegriel or other variants) is unique to the Shepherd. The angel who shuts the beast's mouth echoes Daniel 6:22 (the angel who shut the lions' mouths).*
